stories.h: Showers linger Sunday; snow likely at Stevens, White passes Monday
stories.s: After Saturday night's atmospheric-river storm, showers continue Sunday with highs in the 50s. Snow levels drop to about 4,000 feet Monday, so snow is likely at Stevens and White passes but not Snoqualmie.

stories.h: Democrats win Yakima Valley's 14th District for first time in 34 years
stories.s: Zeke Morfín and Chelsea Dimas took both 14th District House seats, and Democrats also flipped a 12th District seat, their first wins east of the Cascades outside Spokane County since 2008, helping secure a House supermajority.

stories.h: More damage found at Orcas ferry terminal; wind slows repairs
stories.s: WSF says high winds stalled scaffolding work and crews found more damage on the transfer span. The 22-foot limit for standard vehicles stays in place with no end date; the next update is due Monday.

talking.h: WSU routs Colorado State 73-7 but misses a bowl
talking.s: The Cougars won their first FBS game of the season Saturday in Pullman but will miss a bowl game. Next weekend they travel to Texas State.

coming.s: The Economic and Revenue Forecast Council's quarterly revenue review starts at noon in the Cherberg Building and on Zoom, shaping budget writing ahead of the 2027 session.

coming.h: Next update on Orcas ferry terminal repairs
coming.s: WSF plans to post its next update on the transfer span repairs and vehicle-length limits at Orcas Island.
